work_history.title: Assistant Senior Finance Manager
work_history.description: Leading group finance and reporting, independently managing the relationship with SeaTown Private Capital Master Fund (Temasek-linked PE investor) following a USD 40 million funding commitment including quarterly investor reporting and covenant compliance monitoring. Oversee transfer pricing exercises, annual statutory audit, billing processes, and ongoing cash flow management for the group, while liaising with tax agents, bankers, and company secretaries. Lead a finance team of 5, continuing to strengthen the group's financial control framework and SOPs.

work_history.title: Finance Manager
work_history.description: Built the group's monthly reporting function and financial control framework from the ground up, including consolidation templates, chart of accounts, SOPs, and accounting policy manual, using Quickbooks and Microsoft-based finance systems. Reduced the group closing cycle from 3 months to within 10 business days, including consolidation of newly acquired entities, for a business generating over USD 20 million in revenue. Supported due diligence for the USD 40 million PE funding round through financial data, forecasts, and analysis.

work_history.title: Management Accounting, Manager
work_history.company: Watsons Personal Care Stores Sdn Bhd
work_history.description: Led a team of 3, delivering monthly management reporting, forecasting and annual budgeting across a retail network of approximately 700 stores nationwide, partnering with the Finance Director to analyse performance and variances. Ensured timely, accurate financial reporting to regional/group finance and supported Board reporting and executive presentations. Managed the organisation's insurance portfolio and coordinated internal and external audits across all reporting areas.

work_history.title: Assistant Head of Finance
work_history.description: Led a regional finance team of 8, overseeing finance operations across Malaysia and subsidiaries in 7+ countries (including Vietnam, Thailand, Hong Kong and Japan), establishing finance processes and accounting procedures for newly incorporated entities. Managed cash flow planning for overseas subsidiaries to ensure adequate operating funds, and monitored trade receivables ageing to reduce credit risk across the group. Prepared monthly consolidated financial statements for group reporting and led budgeting, quarterly forecasting and cash flow planning across all entities using Sage.

work_history.title: Accountant
work_history.description: Supported group finance operations across Malaysia and overseas entities, assisting with monthly consolidated reporting, budgeting, and statutory compliance. Built foundational expertise in multi-country finance processes, leading to promotion into a regional finance leadership role.

work_history.title: Audit Senior / Team Leader
work_history.description: Led audit teams across diverse industries (retail, manufacturing, trading, construction, technology, IT, logging), reviewing working papers to ensure quality and compliance with auditing standards. Managed client relationships and delivery within tight deadlines; served as Senior in-charge for special engagements including financial due diligence and IPO listings on the AIM Market and ACE Market. Led an overseas audit engagement in Suzhou, China, and coached junior auditors to strengthen team capability and audit quality.

education: Bachelor's Degree — University of East London (2010); Sunway University College (2012)
